approvedScope: english rush V1.0.1: robot chạy phố neon, trả lời 48 câu tiếng Anh THPT để nhảy; ba tim, combo, kỷ lục cục bộ và xếp hạng trực tuyến; máy tính ngang và điện thoại tự thích ứng; hiệu ứng tổng hợp và nhạc nền riêng cho ba trò chơi do người tạo cung cấp.
title: english rush
description: Giúp robot vượt tinh thể giữa phố neon bằng kiến thức Tiếng Anh THPT, nối combo và chinh phục kỷ lục.
visualDirection: Robot thân thiện chạy ngang trong phố neon xanh tím, điểm nhấn cyan và magenta, nền parallax nhiều lớp; câu hỏi kính mờ, chữ rõ và hiệu ứng hạt khi nhảy.
playerFantasy: Điều khiển khả năng vượt chướng ngại vật của robot bằng kiến thức Tiếng Anh.
objective: Trả lời đúng càng nhiều càng tốt trước khi hết ba tim để phá kỷ lục.
coreLoop: Tự chạy → đến chướng ngại vật → dừng đường chạy và trả lời → đúng thì nhảy, tăng điểm/combo; sai thì mất tim và đọc giải thích → tiếp tục hoặc kết quả → chơi lại.

controls.answer: Mouse/touch answer or keys 1–4 / A–D; consume exactly once per question.
controls.continue: Click/tap Tiếp tục after feedback if lives remain

progression: Tăng nhẹ tốc độ theo điểm; câu hỏi không lặp trong mỗi chu kỳ 48 câu. Không có màn thắng cuối.
failureState: Kết thúc ở 0 tim; vẫn hiển thị đáp án đúng và giải thích cuối cùng.

mechanics: Run automatically; trigger a question at a safe obstacle distance before contact. Freeze world movement and robot animation during question while real-time answer countdown continues.

Start with 3 lives. Each wrong answer or timeout removes exactly one life, sets combo to zero and plays collision once. Feedback shows correct answer plus Vietnamese explanation. Continue explicitly if lives remain; zero lives leads to gameover with same explanation.

Correct answer: hide question, play automatic jump over obstacle, increment combo, award 100 + min(100,20*(combo-1)) integer points. First correct answer gives 100. No points for distance or wrong answers.
Use 15 seconds per question, 20 seconds for long sentence structure items. Countdown uses elapsed seconds and is suspended when document is hidden to avoid unfair timeouts.

48 authored THPT questions, exactly 16 fill-in-the-blank, 16 sentence-structure, 16 meaning/idioms; each has 4 distinct options, exactly one correct id and Vietnamese explanation. Shuffle question bag and option ids, no repeats until all 48 used; avoid immediate cross-bag repetition.
Answer by 1–4 or A–D mapped to displayed positions; mouse and touch have identical results. Prevent key repeat and duplicate answers during transitions.
Base speed 260 logical units/second grows with score to a cap of 420; speed does not shorten question time. Jump collision bypass occurs only on a correct answer.

Gameover freezes finalScore as a nonnegative safe integer. Store personal best defensively in localStorage; failure of storage does not block play. Submit final result once to approved leaderboard; offline failure never blocks restart.
Restart resets points, lives, combo, question timer, animation, feedback and pending obstacle while preserving high score and mute preference.

SFX only: synthesize jump upward chirp, correct-answer two-note ting and collision low buzz with Web Audio. No BGM, voices or external MP3. Provide sound toggle and gesture-gated audio initialization.
acceptanceCriteria: Ready shows objective, controls, three-life rule and Start; Start reliably begins the runner.
All four keyboard number/letter pairs, clicks and taps select the same visible answer positions and only one answer is accepted per question.
World and character stop for questions while timer counts down; correct answer visibly jumps the obstacle and awards exact combo score.
Wrong answer and timeout each remove exactly one life; feedback provides correct answer and Vietnamese explanation; continuation requires player action.
Third error reaches gameover with frozen finalScore, last correction, local best and retry. Retry starts a fresh round. Leaderboard service unavailable still permits every gameplay state.
Exactly 48 validated unique questions, 16 per category, four unique shuffled answers and one correct answer; 15/20 second limits follow question type.
Full stage, HUD, question, four choices and controls remain visible without scrolling at desktop landscape and mobile portrait/landscape. Use computePresentationFit with width and height on resize.
Exactly one opaque scenic background visible at any time. Parallax layers remain transparent and ground/obstacle visuals derive from authoritative worldLayout.

Each robot run/jump/hit action uses its exclusive sheet, correct state-selected frames, stable height and unstretched cells; inspect identity, articulation, foot contacts, recovery and run-loop closure.
Unavailable art uses declared readable animated fallbacks, not invisible actors. Audio is unlocked by gesture, muted reliably, synthesized per approved event and never plays BGM.
Leaderboard receives final safe integer once per gameover and never test scores; testMode suppresses writes and exposes truthful submission lifecycle.

sceneBrief.overall: Educational arcade with creator-provided background music per game and preserved synthesized runner feedback.

jump.context: Once on successful robot takeoff after a correct answer.
jump.sound: A quick synthesized rising pitch chirp, light and buoyant.

powerup.context: Once when the selected answer is correct and points/combo increase.
powerup.sound: Two clear synthesized bell-like notes, ting-ting, encouraging but unobtrusive.

hit.context: Once when a wrong answer or timeout causes obstacle collision and loss of one life.
hit.sound: A short synthesized low-pitch buzz or impact, not harsh; distinct from success.

bgm.context: Music loops during the selected game and stops on returning to the menu.
bgm.sound: Creator-selected tracks: Attack of the Killer Queen for runner, Tokyovania for Memory Match, Hajimari no Kyoku for Word Quest.
